kind: task that changes a file already in outputs

facts.fact: Our price is the supplier's cost times 1.25, rounded to whole SEK.
Change the existing price list file. No new file, no copy.
Items the supplier's new rates do not mention keep their cost and price.
The new prices are valid from {{today+30d}}; the file's valid-from line must say so.
Change nothing else in the file.
